Panel.summary: Panel is the reusable retained scroll-capable surface primitive with theme-role rendering, explicit background/style overrides, bounded border vocabulary, visual outsets, and optional named-group semantics.

methods.Panel: Constructs a backplane ScrollableControl whose ordinary appearance resolves through the panel theme role.
methods.border_style: Returns the retained none, line, sunken, or raised border policy.
methods.set_border_style: Validates the closed border vocabulary, commits a real change, and invalidates paint and semantics atomically.
methods.background: Resolves the explicit background override or the leading color of the active theme material.
methods.has_background_override: Reports whether a caller-owned background currently supersedes theme material fill.
methods.set_background: Installs a caller-owned solid background and invalidates painting.
methods.clear_background: Removes the solid override and restores active theme material resolution.
methods.style: Returns the explicit legacy BasicControlStyle or the current theme fallback.
methods.has_style_override: Reports whether legacy style colors override the role recipe.
methods.set_style: Installs an explicit BasicControlStyle for compatibility painting and semantic appearance.
methods.clear_style: Removes the explicit compatibility style and resumes theme recipes.
methods.visual_role: Returns the theme role used when no explicit style/background is authoritative.
methods.set_visual_role: Accepts only panel-compatible roles, then invalidates style, paint, and semantics.
methods.on_paint: Records the resolved material or compatibility panel frame into the renderer-neutral Painter.
methods.visual_outsets: Reports shadow/filter outsets from the active surface material, or none for legacy style painting.
methods.semantic_descriptor: Projects a named Panel as an exposed group and leaves an unnamed structural Panel unexposed.

methods.GroupBox: Constructs a Panel with authored caption text and the control-caption font policy.

PictureBox.status: OBSERVED: bundle 002 split; M4 build, focused tests, and Screen Sharing pass

PictureBox.summary: PictureBox is a noninteractive Panel image presenter over Window-owned generational resources, with five canonical sizing modes, bounded opacity, inspectable image geometry, and image semantics.

methods.PictureBox: Constructs a clipped image surface and registers its reflected SizeMode property schema.
methods.image: Returns the retained generational ImageId, which may be empty or stale.
methods.set_image: Validates Window ownership when attached, selects the resource, and publishes image_changed after invalidation.
methods.clear_image: Routes through set_image with an empty ImageId so clearing obeys the same event order.
methods.has_valid_image: Reports whether the current ImageId resolves in the attached Window registry.
methods.image_size: Returns current resource pixel dimensions in logical Size form, or an empty size when unavailable.
methods.size_mode: Returns normal, stretch, auto-size, centered, or aspect-preserving zoom policy.
methods.set_size_mode: Validates the closed sizing vocabulary and updates measurement/paint/property state atomically.
methods.image_opacity: Returns the retained image alpha multiplier.
methods.set_image_opacity: Accepts only finite values from zero through one and invalidates painting.
methods.image_bounds: Computes the local destination rectangle from content bounds, source dimensions, and size mode.
methods.image_changed: Returns the event published after a complete image selection change.
methods.measure: Uses source dimensions for auto-size and otherwise preserves ordinary Panel sizing constraints.
methods.on_paint: Paints the Panel first, clips to content, and records the live image at resolved bounds and opacity.
methods.hit_test_local: Keeps PictureBox noninteractive so it does not intercept its container.
methods.semantic_descriptor: Projects an image role, authored accessible text, and the current resource identity without exposing pixels.

Label.summary: Label is a noninteractive retained text primitive with inherited typography roles, explicit font/color overrides, horizontal and vertical alignment, word wrapping, bounded line count, line spacing, mnemonics, and static-text semantics.

methods.Label: Constructs retained text and reflected Text, Font, ForeColor, and MaximumLines properties.
methods.text: Returns the authored UTF-8 text including any mnemonic marker.
methods.set_text: Commits text, publishes text_changed, and avoids ancestor layout work for fixed-size telemetry labels.
methods.font: Resolves an explicit font or the active Theme typography token selected by text_style_role.
methods.has_font_override: Reports whether a caller-owned FontSpec supersedes Theme typography.
methods.set_font: Validates and installs an explicit FontSpec with measure, paint, and semantic invalidation.
methods.clear_font: Removes the explicit font and resumes inherited role typography.
methods.text_style_role: Returns the body, control, caption, heading, title, or monospace typography role.
methods.set_text_style_role: Validates the role and updates inherited typography without disturbing an explicit font.
methods.foreground: Resolves an explicit color or the active panel-role text color.
methods.has_foreground_override: Reports whether a caller-owned text color is active.
methods.set_foreground: Installs an explicit foreground color and invalidates paint and semantics.
methods.clear_foreground: Removes the explicit color and resumes Theme text color.
methods.alignment: Returns per-line near, center, or far horizontal alignment.
methods.set_alignment: Validates and commits horizontal alignment without changing measurement.
methods.vertical_alignment: Returns near, center, or far placement for the complete line block.
methods.set_vertical_alignment: Validates and commits vertical block alignment.
methods.text_wrapping: Returns no-wrap or renderer-neutral word wrapping policy.
methods.set_text_wrapping: Validates wrapping policy and invalidates size, paint, and semantics.
methods.line_spacing: Returns the font-size multiplier used between retained baselines.
methods.set_line_spacing: Accepts only finite values from 0.75 through 3.0 and invalidates affected phases.
methods.maximum_lines: Returns zero for unlimited lines or the positive measure/paint line ceiling.
methods.set_maximum_lines: Accepts zero through 4096, bounds desired height and actual painting, and leaves full semantic text intact.
methods.use_mnemonic: Reports whether ampersands define a displayed mnemonic.
methods.set_use_mnemonic: Toggles mnemonic display parsing and focus-next routing.
methods.text_changed: Returns the event published after retained text commits.
methods.measure: Wraps text against the active constraint, applies MaximumLines, and derives content size unless fixed bounds win.
methods.on_paint: Records aligned visible lines with the resolved font, foreground, spacing, and line ceiling.
methods.hit_test_local: Always declines hits so text labels remain transparent to container interaction.
methods.semantic_descriptor: Projects full displayed text as an exposed static-text node independently of visual line limiting.

methods.ButtonBase: Constructs a focusable hand-cursor command and registers reflected text, font, image, and content-padding properties.
methods.text: Returns authored button text including mnemonic markers.
methods.set_text: Commits text and invalidates measure, paint, and semantics before publishing text_changed.
methods.font: Returns the explicit button content font.
methods.set_font: Validates and commits the FontSpec for content measurement and painting.
methods.style: Returns the explicit compatibility style or active Theme basic style.
methods.has_style_override: Reports whether compatibility frame/text painting is authoritative.
methods.set_style: Installs an explicit BasicControlStyle and invalidates visual/semantic state.
methods.clear_style: Removes compatibility colors and resumes role-recipe rendering.
methods.image: Returns the direct generational ImageId, if direct-image selection is active.
methods.set_image: Validates Window ownership, selects direct image mode, and clears key/index selection atomically.
methods.clear_image: Clears direct/key/index image selection through the common image mutation law.
methods.image_list: Returns the retained ImageList owner used for state/density resolution.
methods.set_image_list: Validates liveness, Window ownership, and current index before reconnecting change observation.
methods.image_index: Returns the selected ImageList index or -1 when index selection is inactive.
methods.set_image_index: Validates range, selects index mode, and clears direct/key selection atomically.
methods.image_key: Returns the UTF-8 ImageList key used by key selection mode.
methods.set_image_key: Validates UTF-8 and length, selects key mode, and clears direct/index selection.
methods.image_alignment: Returns independent image alignment used for overlay content.
methods.set_image_alignment: Validates the nine-position vocabulary and commits paint/semantic alignment.
methods.text_alignment: Returns text or combined-group alignment within padded content bounds.
methods.set_text_alignment: Validates the nine-position vocabulary and commits paint/semantic alignment.
methods.text_image_relation: Returns overlay or ordered horizontal/vertical image-text composition.
methods.set_text_image_relation: Validates composition vocabulary and invalidates measure, paint, and semantics.
methods.image_gap: Returns logical separation used when image and text do not overlay.
methods.set_image_gap: Accepts a finite zero-to-64 gap and invalidates size and rendering.
methods.content_padding: Returns explicit left/top/right/bottom insets between frame and command content.
methods.set_content_padding: Validates finite zero-to-128 insets and applies them to desired size and content geometry atomically.
methods.use_mnemonic: Reports whether authored ampersands define command mnemonics.
methods.set_use_mnemonic: Toggles mnemonic parsing and invalidates retained content and semantics.
methods.perform_click: Runs availability and validation gates, then invokes the same authoritative activation path as user input.
methods.pressed_visual: Combines retained pointer and keyboard press states into the current visual cue.
methods.focused_visual: Reports the retained focus cue state.
methods.hovered_visual: Reports the retained hover cue state.
methods.expanded_state: Returns absent for ordinary commands or collapsed/expanded for disclosure owners.
methods.set_expanded_state: Commits optional disclosure state and invalidates visual and semantic projection.
methods.clicked: Returns the lifetime-safe command event published by the authoritative activation path.
methods.text_changed: Returns the event published after authored text commits.
methods.measure: Combines resolved image/text geometry, relation, gap, and ContentPadding under the available constraint.
methods.on_paint: Selects compatibility or theme rendering, records frame/material cues, then lays out image and text.
methods.visual_outsets: Reports active material shadows unless compatibility style painting is selected.
methods.on_pointer: Maintains hover/engaged/pressed state and qualifies activation through normalized primary-pointer input.
methods.on_key: Maintains Space/Enter pressed state and activates only on the matching normalized release.
methods.on_focus_changed: Commits focus cues and cancels incomplete keyboard presses when focus leaves.
methods.on_activate: Publishes clicked through the lifetime-safe event path.
methods.semantic_descriptor: Projects button role, displayed name, disabled/focused/expanded state, and press action.
methods.on_semantic_action: Routes semantic press through perform_click and rejects unrelated actions.

Card.status: OBSERVED: bundle 001 split; M4 build and focused tests pass
Card.capture_note: Screen Sharing crop from the M4 File Manager Demoboard showing four Card states through the ReviewCard specialization; the first card is selected and focused.
Card.summary: Card is a retained header/body/footer composition with explicit section ownership, theme-derived or caller-owned layout, optional interaction, selection state, painter-neutral material rendering, and semantic projection.

methods.Card: Constructs an empty Card and selects the theme's card visual role; sections remain absent until installed.
methods.header: Returns the currently retained header child, or null when that role is empty.
methods.body: Returns the currently retained body child, or null when that role is empty.
methods.footer: Returns the currently retained footer child, or null when that role is empty.
methods.set_header: Installs an unparented control in the header role and returns the detached predecessor; cross-role reuse and already-parented controls are rejected atomically.
methods.set_body: Installs an unparented control in the body role and returns the detached predecessor; ownership and typed invalidation match the other section setters.
methods.set_footer: Installs an unparented control in the footer role and returns the detached predecessor; ownership and typed invalidation match the other section setters.
methods.card_layout: Returns the stored explicit CardLayout value; use effective_card_layout to observe the active theme-derived value.
methods.uses_theme_layout: Reports whether structural spacing and extents currently come from the inherited Theme.
methods.effective_card_layout: Resolves either structural Theme tokens or the explicit CardLayout into the active layout contract.
methods.set_card_layout: Validates bounded finite padding, gaps, and extents, then makes the supplied layout authoritative and invalidates measure through semantics.
methods.reset_card_layout_to_theme: Restores inherited structural Theme tokens as the layout authority.
methods.interactive: Reports whether the Card participates in hit testing, focus, activation, and selectable item semantics.
methods.set_interactive: Enables or disables interaction, synchronizes focusability, and clears hover/press/focus state when interaction is removed.
methods.set_selected: Commits selection synchronously, invalidates visual and semantic state, then publishes selected_changed once for a real change.
methods.selection_behavior: Returns whether activation leaves selection manual, selects, or toggles selection.
methods.set_selection_behavior: Selects an explicit activation/selection policy; invalid enum values are rejected without mutation.
methods.hovered_visual: Reports the retained hover cue state used by Theme recipe resolution.
methods.pressed_visual: Reports the retained pointer/keyboard press cue state.
methods.focused_visual: Reports the retained focus cue state.
methods.activated: Returns the activation event. When selection behavior is enabled, selection commits before this event is published.
methods.selected_changed: Returns the selection-change event published after retained selection commits.
methods.measure: Measures current header, body, and footer snapshots defensively, respects mutation during callbacks, and adds only gaps between present sections.
methods.arrange: Allocates header from the top, footer from the bottom, and body through the remaining padded extent.
methods.on_paint: Resolves the current card Theme recipe and records its material/focus ring, unless inherited Panel style/background overrides are authoritative.
methods.visual_outsets: Reports compositor outsets from the active material shadows or delegates to Panel when a Panel override is active.
methods.hit_test_local: Admits local hit testing only while the Card is explicitly interactive.
methods.on_pointer: Tracks normalized enter/leave and primary-button press/release state; qualified click activation remains the shared Control activation path.
methods.on_key: Tracks Space/Enter as a retained press and invokes the same activation path on the matching key release.
methods.on_focus_changed: Commits the focus cue and cancels incomplete keyboard presses when focus leaves.
methods.on_activate: Applies the configured selection behavior, then publishes activated if the selection callback did not dispose the Card.
methods.semantic_descriptor: Projects an interactive Card as a selectable list item and carries selected, busy, or invalid state into the semantic graph.
methods.on_semantic_action: Routes semantic press through activation, semantic select through retained selection, and delegates unrelated actions to Panel.

methods.MasterDetailView: Constructs private SplitContainer infrastructure and configures it from the active structural layout policy; visual attachment remains lazy.
methods.initialize_control_tree: Attaches the owned SplitContainer exactly once.
methods.master: Returns the control occupying the master role.
methods.detail: Returns the control occupying the detail role.

methods.split_container: Returns the genuine retained SplitContainer used for rendering, accessibility, pointer dragging, and keyboard splitter behavior.
methods.master_detail_layout: Returns the stored explicit layout value; use effective_master_detail_layout for the active policy.
methods.uses_theme_layout: Reports whether current splitter dimensions and breakpoint derive from structural Theme tokens.
methods.effective_master_detail_layout: Resolves inherited structural Theme geometry or the explicit bounded layout.
methods.set_master_detail_layout: Validates finite ordered extents, makes the explicit layout authoritative, reconfigures the splitter, and invalidates all affected retained phases.
methods.reset_master_detail_layout_to_theme: Restores inherited structural Theme geometry and reconfigures the genuine splitter.
methods.display_mode: Returns the requested automatic or explicit presentation mode.
methods.set_display_mode: Selects automatic, side-by-side, master-only, or detail-only presentation; invalid values fail atomically.
methods.effective_display_mode: Returns the presentation currently applied after responsive resolution.
methods.compact_detail_visible: Reports which role automatic compact presentation should expose.
methods.set_compact_detail_visible: Selects master or detail for the next automatic compact arrangement.
methods.show_master: Convenience operation selecting the master role in compact automatic mode.
methods.show_detail: Convenience operation selecting the detail role in compact automatic mode.
methods.presentation_changed: Returns events describing previous/current applied mode and whether accommodation caused the transition.
methods.measure: Measures stable snapshots of both role controls, tolerates mutation during callbacks, and combines desired size according to resolved orientation/mode.
methods.arrange: Configures and attaches the splitter, resolves responsive mode from final bounds, applies collapse with an explicit origin, and fills the view.
methods.semantic_descriptor: Projects an optional named group whose value reports side-by-side, master, or detail presentation.
